Background / History
Richie Strauss looked forward to his 18th birthday for over a decade, dreaming of escaping the dirt and violence of Coal City and joining the Navy, with typical naive dreams of seeing the world and making a difference in it. After basic, he was stationed to a security team at NORCAL (Naval Office of Robotics, Cybernetics, and Artificial Life) where he spent long boring days watching security cameras and walking perimeters. This wasn't the glamorous life he had envisioned. When the opportunity to volunteer for an exiting research project appeared, he convinced his best friend Johnson Ribault to apply along with him. After his very first mission, Richie realized he hadn't been built to be an agent of peace or justice. He was just a bully assassin. He went AWOL and made his way back to Coal City, hoping to blend in to the huge cesspool of humanuity as best he could. His street moniker "The Bismarck" was given to him by an elderly German man he saved from a mugging. Richie didn't realize at the time that the Bismarck was a Nazi ship, and he's now not terribly happy about the name, but it stuck, and it carries weight. Johnson didn't survive their inaugural mission. Richie feels somewhat responsible, and does what he can to provide for Johnson's family.
